role: Original title-screen backdrop below the Crown War citadel. No characters or text.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original landscape title-screen background plate for the Bobozan Crown War game, 16:9 panoramic composition, 2048x1152.
Primary request: create a new scene at the FOOT OF A GREAT CASTLE, seen from its forecourt, with the Crown War citadel looming closely overhead, not a faraway small castle. No people or creatures.
Scene: the viewer stands on a broad dark flagstone forecourt at the base of enormous medieval royal castle ramparts. A massive arched portcullis gate is centered horizontally, immediately beyond a short broad ascending stair. Heavy fortress buttresses frame the entrance, crown-shaped central spires rise above the wall, with more towers receding at upper right. Worn deep-red and dark teal tournament banners hang beside the gate bearing only small simple crown/lantern pictograms; sparse warm amber lamps mark the path into the gate. A restrained blue dusk sky with carved cloud shapes above. The gate is not a void of horror; quiet golden interior illumination implies the coming contest and a resolute hopeful journey.
Style/medium: handcrafted colored woodcut / linocut illustrated fantasy, crisp heavy ink contours, engraved shadow hatching, limited inks, controlled subtle micro-pixel stepping and woodgrain stipple in shadows. Match the existing Crown War story's ink-printed paper quality and mature storybook feel. NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D, NOT smooth digital concept painting, NOT coarse blocky Minecraft pixel art. Clear architectural silhouettes with thoughtful structural detail, much less visual noise on the ground. Deep midnight navy and slate-blue stone, cream/gold cut highlights, copper amber lamplight and restrained dark red banners.
Composition: the fortress occupies the UPPER 55% of this wide landscape. The CENTRAL 40% must show the castle gate and tower unmistakably when cropped to a narrow phone portrait. The lower 45% is comparatively quiet, unoccupied dark stone courtyard with broad restrained planar flagstone shapes; keep lower-left and bottom-center very dark with little detail so the game overlays menu buttons and character illustrations there. Avoid prominent foreground props crossing those spaces. Scale feels large and close, architecture recedes naturally, the camera is low at a traveler's height beneath the citadel. No letterbox, edge frame or card border. Fill the whole image with scene.
Constraints: original artwork; no text, no lettering, no logo, no UI, no numbers, no characters, no people, no silhouettes of people, no weapons in foreground; no tavern, bar counter, bottles or drinking; no landscape watercolors or distant mountain panorama; no bright sun disc behind the castle. High quality production background, coherent light and perspective.
inspection: Inspected full output: central gate survives portrait crop; strong close castle silhouette; empty dark foreground; no letters, people, tavern elements or UI.
